By using a CTE that computes the maximum salary per department in a single pass (using GROUP BY), and then joining back to employees, the query becomes a single scan of employees plus a single scan of the CTE. The index on (department_id, salary DESC) can be used to efficiently compute the maximum salary per department, and the join condition uses the indexed columns. This transformation preserves the exact result set (employees with the highest salary in their department) and maintains the same output columns and aliases.
